blocks.text: What this usually means in UK cars

items.title: Metal shavings are the most ominous symptom
items.description: Metal shavings in engine oil means internal components are wearing at an accelerated rate - and almost always precedes catastrophic failure. In our 24,650 quote dataset, we identified four primary causes:

cards.title: Bearing wear - 45% of cases
cards.text: Copper/bronze particles from connecting rod or main bearings. Cause: oil starvation, low oil, high mileage. Repair: £800-£10,000+.
cards.fullText: Bearing wear - 45% of cases Copper/bronze particles from connecting rod or main bearings. Cause: oil starvation, low oil, high mileage. Repair: £800-£10,000+.

cards.title: Camshaft wear - 25% of cases
cards.text: Iron/steel particles from camshaft lobes or lifters. Cause: oil starvation or poor oil quality. Repair: £1,000-£3,000+.
cards.fullText: Camshaft wear - 25% of cases Iron/steel particles from camshaft lobes or lifters. Cause: oil starvation or poor oil quality. Repair: £1,000-£3,000+.

cards.title: Piston/cylinder wear - 20% of cases
cards.text: Aluminium particles from pistons or cylinder walls. Cause: overheating, bore scoring. Repair: £2,500-£10,000+.
cards.fullText: Piston/cylinder wear - 20% of cases Aluminium particles from pistons or cylinder walls. Cause: overheating, bore scoring. Repair: £2,500-£10,000+.

cards.title: Timing chain wear - 10% of cases
cards.text: Iron/steel particles from chain or guides. Cause: tensioner failure, high mileage. Repair: £700-£2,700+.
cards.fullText: Timing chain wear - 10% of cases Iron/steel particles from chain or guides. Cause: tensioner failure, high mileage. Repair: £700-£2,700+.

blocks.text: The rule: If you can see metal particles with the naked eye, you have a serious problem. You cannot "monitor" metal in your oil - you must act immediately.

items.title: Metal shavings issues by make and model
From normal to critical in one glance
⚠️ Stop driving immediately - metal shavings means failure
items.description: Metal particles in engine oil indicate internal wear or failure. The type of metal reveals the source:

items: Copper/bronze = Bearings. This is the most critical. Bearings are failing.
Iron/steel = Cylinder walls or camshafts. Valve train or cylinder wear.
Metal particles act as abrasives - they cause more damage every time the engine runs
The source of the metal is actively failing
Continued driving will cause catastrophic failure
What could be a £800 bearing replacement becomes a £2,500-£10,000+ engine replacement

blocks.text: The oil analysis option: Oil analysis costs £30-£50 and identifies exactly which metals are present, pinpointing the failing component. This is the smartest investment you can make.

blocks.question: How much does oil analysis cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: £30-£50 from UK-based labs. This identifies exactly which metals are present and pinpoints the failing component.

blocks.question: Can metal shavings in oil be fixed?
blocks.answer: Sometimes - if caught early, bearing replacement is possible. But if the crankshaft is damaged, the engine must be replaced.

blocks.question: Why are metal shavings so serious?
blocks.answer: Metal in oil means internal components are failing. The particles themselves are abrasive and cause more damage every time the engine runs.

blocks.question: How do I check for metal shavings?
blocks.answer: Check the oil on the dipstick with a white cloth. Check the oil filter (cut it open). Send an oil sample for analysis.

blocks.question: What colour metal shavings are worst?
blocks.answer: Copper/bronze (bearings) is the most critical. Bearings failing means the engine is about to catastrophically fail.
